description: Scoped grant so the bundled Setnayan web app (loaded as a remote URL) can run system-browser OAuth (start/stop the localhost loopback, open the provider consent page in the system browser, listen for the oauth:// redirect event), the S8 stream-key commands (own-channel paste + hosted-channel nonce exchange — build-sessions/encoder/S8.md), and the S10 keep-awake assertion held around the live-broadcast encoder (build-sessions/encoder/S10.md). No filesystem / shell-exec / arbitrary-IPC is granted.
